Human Resource Officer Job at Ekini White Tulip Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Ekini White Tulip Consulting Limited is a multi-disciplinary team of experienced professionals, offering result-oriented Marketing/Sales Advisory Support, Human Capital Development/Training and Recruitment/Selection services. Our mission is to produce and develop leaders and managers for today and tomorrow.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Officer

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The candidate will take some responsibilities for the personnel and human capital issues.
	Key accountabilities are administration and policies implementation for recruitment/staffing, performance management, compliance, staff records/documentation, compensation, etc.


Requirements


	B.Sc Degree in Management or Administration or similar discipline
	Minimum 2 years of cognate experience in a structure environment
	HR professional qualifications/Membership an advantage
	Self-starter, capable of working with little or no supervision.


Compensation
Up to 250,000 Monthly depending on experience and qualification.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "title": "Telecom Sales Agent",
  "description": "Fort Knox Outsourcing is an outsourcing organization.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Telecom Sales Agent

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Promote and sell the company&#39;s telecom products and services to prospective customers.
	Identify and acquire new customers through field sales, referrals, and direct marketing activities.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers.
	Achieve and exceed monthly sales and revenue targets.
	Educate customers on product features, pricing, and promotional offers.
	Process customer applications and ensure all required documentation is completed accurately.
	Resolve customer inquiries and provide exceptional customer service.
	Conduct market intelligence and identify new business opportunities within the assigned territory.
	Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity reports.
	Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.


Requirements


	Minimum of an OND, HND, or Bachelor&#39;s degree in any discipline.
	Minimum of 2 years of proven sales experience in the telecommunications or insurance industry is mandatory.
	Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong customer relationship management and prospecting skills.
	Ability to work independently and thrive in a target-driven environment.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is an added advantage.
	Must reside in or around Ikeja, Lagos.


Salary
N213,318 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their to: recruitment@fortknoxoutsourcing.com using the Job Position and location as subject of the mail.",

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Customer Experience Supervisor (Multi-Branch Electronics Retail)",
  "description": "Prestigious Consulting is a professional HR consultancy firm. We focus on improving organizational performance through strategic people &amp; process management.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Customer Experience Supervisor (Multi-Branch Electronics Retail)

Job Location: Ikoyi/Lekki, Lagos (Multi-Branch Oversight)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced Customer Experience &amp; After-Sales Supervisor to lead and standardize customer service operations across multiple retail branches within a fast-growing consumer electronics business.
	This role is designed for a professional who understands that excellent customer service extends beyond responding to complaints&mdash;it involves building systems, developing people, improving after-sales support, strengthening customer trust, and ensuring a consistent customer experience across every branch.
	The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer service within a structured consumer electronics, home appliances, mobile devices, ICT, or technology retail business and possess a strong understanding of warranty administration, product support, service recovery, and customer retention.
	Candidates without relevant electronics retail customer service experience will not be considered.


Key Responsibilities
Customer Experience Leadership:


	Lead customer service operations across all retail branches.
	Develop and implement customer service SOPs, service standards, and escalation procedures.
	Standardize customer experience across all locations.
	Ensure every customer interaction reflects professionalism, responsiveness, and brand excellence.
	Drive a customer-first culture across the organization.


Complaint Resolution &amp; Service Recovery:


	Manage complex customer complaints and escalations relating to electronics, home appliances, deliveries, warranties, installations, and after-sales support.
	Develop structured complaint resolution processes that improve turnaround times and customer satisfaction.
	Liaise with manufacturers, distributors, logistics partners, and authorized service centres to resolve customer issues efficiently.
	Ensure customers receive proactive updates until cases are fully resolved.
	Monitor service recovery efforts and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.


After-Sales &amp; Warranty Management:


	Supervise warranty registration, claims processing, repairs, replacements, and returns.
	Ensure compliance with manufacturer warranty policies and internal procedures.
	Monitor turnaround times for repairs and warranty claims.
	Improve after-sales processes to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty.
	Work closely with branch teams to ensure seamless after-sales support.


Multi-Branch Customer Service Oversight:


	Provide operational support and supervision to customer service teams across multiple branches.
	Conduct regular customer service audits and branch visits.
	Ensure consistent implementation of customer service standards across all locations.
	Monitor branch compliance with customer service policies and procedures.
	Identify recurring service issues and implement corrective action plans.


Team Leadership &amp; Development:


	Lead, mentor, and coach Customer Service Officers across all branches.
	Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions.
	Train teams on customer communication, conflict resolution, product knowledge, and service excellence.
	Develop customer service training materials and onboarding processes.
	Foster accountability, professionalism, and continuous learning within the team.


Customer Insights &amp; Experience Improvement:


	Analyze customer feedback, complaint trends, online reviews, and service data.
	Identify root causes of recurring customer issues.
	Recommend process improvements that enhance the overall customer journey.
	Collaborate with Operations, Sales, Logistics, and Inventory teams to improve the end-to-end customer experience.
	Drive initiatives that improve customer loyalty, retention, and brand reputation.


Reporting &amp; Performance Management:


	Develop customer service dashboards and performance reports.
	Monitor key service metrics across all branches.
	Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.
	Track customer satisfaction, complaint resolution timelines, warranty turnaround times, and branch service performance.
	Maintain accurate documentation of all customer interactions and escalated cases.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be measured by:


	Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
	Net Promoter Score (NPS)
	First Contact Resolution Rate
	Complaint Resolution Turnaround Time
	Warranty Claim Turnaround Time
	Number of Escalated Cases
	Customer Retention Rate

Customer Experience Supervisor (Multi-Branch Electronics Retail) Job at Prestigious Consulting




        
    

        
        Prestigious Consulting is a professional HR consultancy firm. We focus on improving organizational performance through strategic people & process management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Experience Supervisor (Multi-Branch Electronics Retail)

Job Location: Ikoyi/Lekki, Lagos (Multi-Branch Oversight)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Customer Experience & After-Sales Supervisor to lead and standardize customer service operations across multiple retail branches within a fast-growing consumer electronics business.
	This role is designed for a professional who understands that excellent customer service extends beyond responding to complaints—it involves building systems, developing people, improving after-sales support, strengthening customer trust, and ensuring a consistent customer experience across every branch.
	The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer service within a structured consumer electronics, home appliances, mobile devices, ICT, or technology retail business and possess a strong understanding of warranty administration, product support, service recovery, and customer retention.
	Candidates without relevant electronics retail customer service experience will not be considered.


Key Responsibilities
Customer Experience Leadership:


	Lead customer service operations across all retail branches.
	Develop and implement customer service SOPs, service standards, and escalation procedures.
	Standardize customer experience across all locations.
	Ensure every customer interaction reflects professionalism, responsiveness, and brand excellence.
	Drive a customer-first culture across the organization.


Complaint Resolution & Service Recovery:


	Manage complex customer complaints and escalations relating to electronics, home appliances, deliveries, warranties, installations, and after-sales support.
	Develop structured complaint resolution processes that improve turnaround times and customer satisfaction.
	Liaise with manufacturers, distributors, logistics partners, and authorized service centres to resolve customer issues efficiently.
	Ensure customers receive proactive updates until cases are fully resolved.
	Monitor service recovery efforts and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.


After-Sales & Warranty Management:


	Supervise warranty registration, claims processing, repairs, replacements, and returns.
	Ensure compliance with manufacturer warranty policies and internal procedures.
	Monitor turnaround times for repairs and warranty claims.
	Improve after-sales processes to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty.
	Work closely with branch teams to ensure seamless after-sales support.


Multi-Branch Customer Service Oversight:


	Provide operational support and supervision to customer service teams across multiple branches.
	Conduct regular customer service audits and branch visits.
	Ensure consistent implementation of customer service standards across all locations.
	Monitor branch compliance with customer service policies and procedures.
	Identify recurring service issues and implement corrective action plans.


Team Leadership & Development:


	Lead, mentor, and coach Customer Service Officers across all branches.
	Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions.
	Train teams on customer communication, conflict resolution, product knowledge, and service excellence.
	Develop customer service training materials and onboarding processes.
	Foster accountability, professionalism, and continuous learning within the team.


Customer Insights & Experience Improvement:


	Analyze customer feedback, complaint trends, online reviews, and service data.
	Identify root causes of recurring customer issues.
	Recommend process improvements that enhance the overall customer journey.
	Collaborate with Operations, Sales, Logistics, and Inventory teams to improve the end-to-end customer experience.
	Drive initiatives that improve customer loyalty, retention, and brand reputation.


Reporting & Performance Management:


	Develop customer service dashboards and performance reports.
	Monitor key service metrics across all branches.
	Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.
	Track customer satisfaction, complaint resolution timelines, warranty turnaround times, and branch service performance.
	Maintain accurate documentation of all customer interactions and escalated cases.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be measured by:


	Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
	Net Promoter Score (NPS)
	First Contact Resolution Rate
	Complaint Resolution Turnaround Time
	Warranty Claim Turnaround Time
	Number of Escalated Cases
	Customer Retention Rate
